_meta.purpose: Central, verifiable registry of every place's fact-checked address and exact map coordinate, with the source used to validate each. This is the single source of truth for map pins.
_meta.rule: Never place a pin from memory or estimation. Verify address + lat/lng against the place's official site, Google/Apple/OpenStreetMap, or Wikipedia's published coordinates; record the source and date here. The build injects lat/lng from this file and fails on any place missing an entry.
_meta.howToUpdate: When a place closes or moves, re-verify against its source, update address/lat/lng/source/verified, and rebuild. Closed places stay (flagged) — keep the entry so the pin and its provenance remain auditable.
_meta.audit: node tools/research.js --geocheck <city-key>  — lists any place on the page missing a verified geocode; must PASS before publishing.
_meta.fields: address, lat, lng, source (URL or naming authority: official|wikipedia|google|apple|osm|yelp), verified (YYYY-MM-DD), confidence (high|med|low), note
